core_cpi_mom.evidence_note: BMO Viewpoint 'Key for Next Week' explicitly states the Consensus value. The same August 9 Viewpoint issue landing page displays 'August 09, 2024 | 15:15'; the BMO site clock is interpreted as America/Toronto (EDT, UTC-04:00), yielding 19:15 UTC. The issue predates the August 14 CPI release by several days.
core_cpi_mom.source_title: Viewpoint | August 9, 2024 — Key for Next Week
